protocol.name: hyperdbdiag_ecsa_v2
protocol.evaluation: six fixed replicate folds; 550 training and 110 evaluation cases per fold
protocol.calibration: five training-only inner groups; refitted models; unchanged frozen selection rule
protocol.arbitration: all evaluation cases; no test-call budget or selected-case gate

protocol.llm_execution: exact frozen primary-input replay including original failures; no repeat substitution
limitations: same development dataset and known scenarios; not a new independent test set
changes from historical main include local policy, arbitration coverage and prompt/transport
replay duration is not end-to-end inference latency
